note: 岚城 (第十章; 剧情总纲 §6 岚城卡: 仙城——白石、风铃、雾; 美术规划 §1 岚城): a high, thin sky close overhead — pale blue-green by day, never the dust-white of 关北; dawn and dusk come pearl and violet through the cloud, the dusk a long rose band under the cloud's grey; nights clear and cold, a deep blue-violet with a bright moon on the white stone. Under cloud a cool pearl grey with a warm cast, lighter than 天驼关's. Indoors the light is soft and even through paper and gauze, the lamps a pale gold.

overcast.note: under cloud (DECISIONS「天气」): pearl grey with a warm cast over the white stone
